Zane: Anyone else moving pieces for the office playoff pool? Need a QB boost.
Hailey: I swapped in T. Lawrence for this week. Felt risky. :grimacing:
Maria: Lol I benched Cook for Ekeler last minute and holy smokes :fire: thanks @Hailey for the tip
Devin: Trade proposal: my WR1 (D. Smith) + bench depth for Zane's RB2? @Zane
Zane: Depends who your RB2 is. also I'm not giving up RB depth for a boom-or-bust WR
Chris: Playoff QB question — start Hurts or Allen? 8-team league with PPR. Quick poll: Hurts/Allen
Hailey: Allen. He’s been cooking.
Maria: Hurts. matchup is juicy
Scorebot: Score update — League Playoffs Week 1: Maria 112, Zane 98 — 4:35 left in 4th
Devin: Also can we schedule a watch party at the office on Sunday? Stove will bring bagels?
Zane: Count me in. I'll bring the terrible fantasy decision-making advice.
Chris: :thumbsup: if you want bagels. :thumbsdown: if you want waffles
Maria: :thumbsup: +1
Hailey: :thumbsup:
Zane: Final note: respect the trade deadline — please ping the commish @Devin if you agreed verbally
Devin: that's me (commish). I'll post final bracket rules in #random before Friday.
thread_preview: Quick fantasy playoff trades, QB poll, and an office watch-party plan — bagels on the line
